message:
No files were changed, so `npm run check` was skipped. The source trace and a small read-only invocation confirmed one launch-time version-cache mismatch path; I’m returning it with the tracked host-specific probe path as a separate artifact concern.[
  {
    "id": "c1",
    "angle": "correctness",
    "file": "src/opencode-executor.js",
    "line": 159,
    "summary": "The CLI major is detected again when building the sandbox command, after the launch arguments were already built. If the V2 cache expires in between, this falls back to a raw `opencode` command and skips credential import.",
    "failure_scenario": "A V2 launch builds V2 arguments, then sandbox setup crosses the configured version-cache TTL. The second detection returns null, so the worker starts without importing its legacy credential and may fail authentication."
  },
  {
    "id": "c2",
    "angle": "altitude",
    "file": ".superpowers/auth-handoff/live-probe-root.txt",
    "line": 1,
    "summary": "This tracked evidence file records a machine-specific absolute path into the author's local Taskferry state.",
    "failure_scenario": "A different checkout or CI environment cannot follow the probe-root pointer, while the committed file also exposes the author's home path and local state-directory name."
  }
]
